description: Bootstraps a few-shot object annotator from an initial annotation file and ground-truth examples, then proposes and embeds regions across the target dataset. Custom UI — Tapis app/job wiring to follow.

annotation_file.description: JSON file containing the initial few-shot annotations to bootstrap from.

ground_truth.description: Directory of ground-truth images used to validate/calibrate the few-shot annotator.

dataset.description: Directory of unlabeled images the few-shot annotator will run over.

proposer_model.description: Patra model card used as the region PROPOSER — generates candidate regions/boxes before embedding & similarity matching against the few-shot examples.

embedder_model.description: Patra model card used as the EMBEDDER — produces feature embeddings for proposed regions, compared against the few-shot examples' embeddings to assign labels.

use_sahi.description: Enable SAHI (Slicing Aided Hyper Inference) — tiles large images into overlapping patches before inference, improving detection of small objects that would otherwise be missed at full-image scale.

tile_size.description: SAHI tile size in pixels — the side length of each square tile the image is sliced into. Only used when SAHI is enabled.

overlap_ratio.description: SAHI tile overlap ratio (0-1) — how much each tile overlaps its neighbors, so an object spanning a tile boundary is still fully captured in at least one tile. Only used when SAHI is enabled.

batch_size.description: Number of images processed per inference batch. Higher values are faster per-image but use more memory.

crop_size.description: Side length in pixels each proposed region is resized/cropped to before embedding.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum detection confidence score (0-1) for a proposed region to be kept.

objectness_threshold.description: Minimum objectness score (0-1) for the proposer to keep a candidate region before it's passed to the embedder.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum embedding similarity score (0-1) for a proposed region to be accepted as a match against a few-shot example.

nms_iou_threshold.description: IoU threshold (0-1) for Non-Maximum Suppression — overlapping detections above this are collapsed to the single highest-scoring one.

fileInputs.name: gt_annotations
fileInputs.description: Optional: stage the GT annotation JSON in instead of reading it in place. If used, point --ann_path at ${JobWorkingDir}/input/annotations.json.

fileInputs.name: gt_images
fileInputs.description: Optional: stage the GT image directory in. If used, point --gt_image_dir at ${JobWorkingDir}/input/gt_images.

fileInputs.name: dataset_images
fileInputs.description: Optional: stage the query image directory in. If used, point --dataset_dir at ${JobWorkingDir}/input/dataset.
